h1: Custom BAM Pennants for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom BAM pennants for events and promotions. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: BAM pennants offer a classic, durable felt construction that holds bold colors and crisp screen-printed logos. Unlike cheaper polyester options, these heavyweight pennants hang flat and resist curling, making them ideal for trade show backdrops, retail displays, or spirit giveaways. Choose from standard 12x30 inch or oversized formats, and add fringe or tassels for an authentic vintage look. Whether you need 50 or 5,000, BAM pennants deliver consistent quality that keeps your brand looking sharp.
heroAltText: Custom BAM pennants with screen-printed logo and fringe, displayed at a trade show booth.
